statements.text: Wyoming law is very clear that AI is not eligible as a candidate for any office, [...] An AI bot is not a qualified elector.

statements.text: Wyoming law is clear that an AI bot CAN'T run for office.  I have written a letter to Cheyenne City Clerk Kristina Jones explaining the reasons why an AI bot should NOT be allowed to run for Mayor of Cheyenne. https://t.co/QBZ2DcZkab
Wyoming law is clear that, to run for office, one must be a ‘qualified elector,’ which necessitates being a real person, [...] Therefore, an AI bot is not a qualified elector.
Will be on NewsNation @NewsNation Elizabeth Vargas Reports @EVargasTV at 3:50 to talk live about the AI candidate for Mayor of Cheyenne that is NOT in compliance with Wyoming State Law.
And we must STOP (Gov.) Mark Gordon's nightmare of outrageously wrong woke wind and woke Big Tech surveillance state data centers.
statements.venue: Facebook post quoted by Cowboy State Daily

statements.text: I won’t tolerate a mockery of our electoral system and will NOT allow our electoral system to be taken advantage of by AI. https://t.co/bTRC9mNwFT
statements.quoted: On May 29, the U.S. District Court for Wyoming entered an order denying a motion for a temporary restraining order filed by Victor Miller, which challenged the Wyoming Secretary of State’s Office’s rejection of Miller’s application for nomination for U.S. Senate. https://t.co/jk8OZxcWKR

statements.text: Both federal and state law are clear: to be a candidate for office, you must be a human being, NOT an AI bot. Listing ‘VIC,’ ‘Victor,’ or any other pseudo name on the application does not comply with Wyoming law. [...] I won’t tolerate a mockery of our electoral system.
